stemMd: Why could buying a disposable bottle be reasonable for a one-time visitor?

options.label: A
options.textMd: The durable container’s cost might outweigh the refill saving on one purchase.

options.label: B
options.textMd: The refill detergent must be less effective.

options.label: C
options.textMd: The visitor necessarily opposes environmental goals.

options.label: D
options.textMd: The refill price per litre was higher.

options.label: E
options.textMd: The cooperative prohibited visitors from using refills.

explanationMd: A lower running price does not guarantee lower total cost when there is an initial investment. With only one expected purchase, the visitor may not save enough to recover it. This is the volunteer’s challenge to the blanket irrationality claim.

distractorRationale.c: The passage offers a cost-based explanation rather than a motive judgment.
